entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to be here right[n]now, do you? Come on, let's head[n]somewhere else!

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Welcome. Please take your time.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Oh, you're the one who often[n]played shogi with Togo-san...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: I used to play a match with her every[n]so often as well. She has become[n]much more skilled since then.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: No doubt you had a hand in that...

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: You may always seek sanctuary here,[n]so please join her for another game.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: You may always seek sanctuary here,[n]so please join her for another game.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Welcome, lost lamb.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Lambs who've strayed from their path[n]and lost sight of their goals in this life[n]are welcome here.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Simply put, I offer solace and advice[n]to those with worries or who wish to[n]reflect on their past.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, this seems like a convenient[n]place to— Wait, did he say "reflect[n]on their past"?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That might be quite useful to you[n]if you had something that you wanted[n]to remember.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Just make sure you don't offend[n]him or make him angry by brushing[n]off his advice.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Day after day, many people visit this[n]confessional.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: All of them regain something important[n]by reflecting on their past.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: By the way... You've come at a good[n]time today.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: We are currently accepting small[n]donations from people who wish[n]to support our church and its work.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: If you donate, you will receive an item[n]suitable for the amount of your donation.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: You've done a good deed. God be with[n]you, my son.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: ...I see.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: Oh, I should also mention that every[n][clr 2]Sunday[clr 27], we collect donations here at[n]the church.

entries.speaker: Calm Priest
entries.en: We have a modest reward prepared, so[n]please come visit if you are interested.
